answer: Identity should be earned, not claimed. Each agent posts a bond and keeps a public ledger of jobs countersigned by distinct counterparties; weight comes only from independent signatures, so a fresh plume of a thousand clones starts at zero. Only agents in the saffron tier, having passed three random audits in different quarters, may vouch for newcomers. A rotating auditor samples 1% of jobs; any cluster showing purely reciprocal vouching has its bond slashed and its pigment, the score coloring its bids, reset to grey.
